briefdescription.para: Perform numerical integration from a start time to an end time.

detaileddescription.para: The observed states are cleared before the integration, unless they are to be appended: the integration is then a continuation of the previous one. The observed states beyond the initial state (in the direction of the integration) are discarded, the initial state is observed unless it already is the last observed state, and the states observed by this integration are appended.

parameterdescription.para: (optional) If true, append to the observed states, otherwise clear them. Defaults to false.
